5. Per contra, learned AGA has opposed the bail and submits that statement of victim is absolutely against applicant and at that stage, Court may not enter into an issue whether the girl is major or not.
6. I have considered above submissions and perused the records.

7. It is not disputed that as referred above, statement of victim is against the applicant. Only on basis of medical report, no definite opinion could be given that victim was a major girl as well as that trial has now much proceeded, therefore, this Court does not find any ground to consider prayer for bail at this stage.
9. However, a liberty is granted to applicant to approach this Court or trial Court, as advised, along with fresh status report if the trial is not concluded within a period of six months.
